items.title: MemState – Transactional, type-safe memory for AI agents (SQLite/Redis)

Recently, AI chip company TsingWei Intelligence completed a Series C financing round exceeding 2 billion yuan. This round was led by Beijing Energy Group, a state-owned enterprise under the Beijing municipal government, with participation from BeiChuangTou, Jiantou Investment, Wuyuefeng Technology Innovation, Chengdu Science and Technology Investment, Huatai Zijin, Zhilu Capital, Zhongnan Bofu, Kailian Capital, Turing Assets, Hardcore Nut Capital, Tuofeng Investment, Miju Capital, Yuntai Capital, He’ertai, and Zhongke Yuanchuang. Existing shareholders, including Jingguorui (Beijing Information Industry Development Investment Fund), Zhongguancun Science City Company, Sensetime Guoxiang Capital, Wenming Investment, Zhuoyuan Asia, Yuanyu Investment, and Koala Fund, continued to reinvest. The funds will primarily be used for the R&D of next-generation reconfigurable computing chips, the deployment of intelligent computing scenarios, and the recruitment of high-end talent. TsingWei Intelligence has already initiated preparations for an IPO.

Currently, "non-GPU" AI chips, represented by Google's TPU, are attracting global attention, triggering a series of chain reactions including fluctuations in the market value of leading GPU companies, increased expectations for Google's stock price, and adjustments in chip orders by internet giants. TsingWei Intelligence is also a representative domestic company developing "non-GPU" AI chips with novel architectures. Its reconfigurable AI chips retain the versatility of GPUs while approaching the energy efficiency advantages of specialized AI chips like TPUs through dynamic operator reconfiguration, earning them the nickname "general-purpose TPU." Currently, TsingWei Intelligence's reconfigurable AI chips have been deployed at scale in over ten intelligent computing centers nationwide, each with thousands of cards.

Public information shows that since 2019, TsingWei Intelligence has completed multiple financing rounds, including angel, Series A, Series B, and one additional round.
